name: Contact storage
description: Provides storage and edit capability for contact messages.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Overview 
 Contact Storage module will provide storage for Contact messages which are fully-fledged entities in Drupal 8.

This plus core contact module aim to provide functionality equivalent to the base-features of Webform or Entity Form.

 The goal is to firm up this functionality in contrib with view to move into core in 8.2.x or later via [#2582955].

 Back to top 

 Features 
 Now 
 
 Message storage 
 Edit messages 
 Delete messages 
 Custom redirect path after submitting messages 
 Admin listing 
 Views integration 
 Views powered admin listing 
 Customize button text 
 Hide preview button 
 
 Via contributed projects 
 
 Field group to add groups 
 CSV serialization to build views to export results 
 Markup to add markup elements 
 Contact storage export another way to add export functionality 
 Contact emails allows to send configurable mails per contact form 
 
 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 None, just core Contact Module.
